short_property: After both receivers are spawned, a receiver panic is propagated.
fix_description: Make cleanup unwind-safe: join both receivers even if the intervening work panics, and propagate a receiver panic before rethrowing another panic.
caveats: This Rust source suggestion requires unwind-enabled panics and compatible join results. Neither the build configuration nor source compilation/correspondence is established; it is not an unconditional source repair. Joining may also block if a receiver cannot finish; the abstract helper's terminating join does not establish source-level progress.
